grapher.label: Sliders
grapher.code:
y = a sin(k x)
a = 2 ; slider 0 .. 4
k = 1 ; slider 0.5 .. 3 ; step 0.5

grapher.label: Axes in π
grapher.code:
units: pi
y = sin(x)
y = cos(x) ; blue

grapher.label: Derivative and integral
grapher.code:
f(x) = x^3 / 3 - x
f'(x) ; orange
int(f(x), -1, 1)
tangent(f(x), 1.5)

grapher.label: Polar
grapher.code:
view: polar
r = 2 sin(3θ)
r = 1 + cos(θ) ; 0 .. 2π

grapher.label: Parametric
grapher.code:
view: parametric
span: 10
(0.2t cos t, 0.2t sin t) ; t = 0 .. 6π

grapher.label: 3D surface
grapher.code:
view: 3d
height: 380
z = (x^2 + y^2) / 5 - 6 ; floor
(6cos t, 6sin t, t / 2) ; 0 .. 6π
